function [dx, lambda] = Recover(varargin)
persistent recoveries;
if isempty(recoveries)
    recoveries = 0;
end
if nargin > 0
    recoveries = recoveries + 1;
    settings = varargin{2};
    dx = zeros(settings.nx, settings.N + 1);
    lambda = zeros(settings.nx, settings.N + 1);
else
    dx = recoveries;
end
end
